nom: Origins Ginzing Glow-Boosting Brightening Face Mask

avis.titre: Must buy -Im on my 4th -obsessed with the Glow
avis.texte: Must buy product. I am about to Purchase my 4th jar of this amazing glow boosting mask cream. I love the texture, love how the tiny beads pop on your face as you smooth this into your face. The consistency is beautiful. Lightweight. Doesn't sit heavy. The glow is very noticeable and I get compliments all the time. This smells amazing. Like semi vitamin c scent. Not overpowering or overwhelming at all. I have sensitive skin and allergies and this really works for me. Such an amazing product. This is my ride or die. If I was on a secret island with limited products I would take this one. The secrets officially out. Anyone scoring low on this item I don't understand why.

This is not a mask - it is a "moisturizer" that doesn't absorb. A mask you leave on for a set amount of time, then rinse. This stuff, you do not rinse (hence a "moisturizer"), but is so sticky and doesn't absorb into your skin, that to call it a moisturizer is probably not accurate either. Just a terrible product, and horrendous marketing all around…
i recieved this in my gratis and i love it! it helped my acne scarring and it leaves my skin with a healthy glow! not greasy or sticky you just have to let it dry and it absorbs into the skin

It feels like this does nothing for my skin. It doesn't feel moisturized after using it, and it doesn't appear to improve anything for my skin. I thought it would have a bright, refreshing scent, but it doesn't. I won't buy again.

This is really a moisturizer not a mask. it doesn't absorb well either. It is very tacky and sticky and balls up on my face. I was hoping for a traditional mask that you could rinse off after using. It does smell really good so that is a plus! You could not wear this under make up either since it doesn't absorb well. Your face would be very tacky. Such a disappointment! I also don't think this would incorporate well with users that use retinols.
I figured this would be a mask that would dry & you would have to wash it off. This is more of a moisturizer, which is not a bad thing but i wish it was a an actual face mask.
Very nice on the skin. Just rub it in, leave it on for a glowing shine. So nice for aging skin, does not enhance any wrinkles.

I was looking for a great hydrating mask and tried out the tester and fell in love with this formula. This mask is incredible. I have combo skin that leans more towards dry and this product has changed my life. I use it nightly as my night time moisturizer. It wears well under makeup too just be mindful and not use to much or it can feel a tad greasy. It absorbs well and works well with my serums (Estee Lauder Advanced Night Repai, Peach&Lily Lactic Acid Serum & Glass Skin Serum)
This is one of my favorites!! It is a leave on mask. I use a thin layer to my face every night and it has made such a difference.
This stuff made me break out so bad!!! I never have acne which I am very very grateful for, but my face and chest is now covered in bumps.
I absolutely love this product. I got it as a sample gift and it quickly became a major part of my skin care. It smells so good and gives a beautiful glow to my face.

This is my go to daily moisturizer. I love the scent, and the quick absorption on my face, and the clean feel. It is the perfect everyday moisturizer for my aging skin. It makes my skin feel good and fresh and revived. I give this product a five star rating.

Omg how much do I LOVE the scent! It's like fresh-peeled tangerines right off the tree. Simply divine. I just wished I loved the product as much as the aroma. As others have mentioned, this is NOT a MASK. It's really a creamy serum that you leave on. I used it at night under my moisturizer and after a month, I didn't notice any changes in my skin tone. No lessening of dark spots. So disappointed.

avis.titre: This is a leave on, not a real mask !
avis.texte: For those 1 star reviews, I believe its not supposed to be washed off or used as a mask. It is a leave in, so after washing your face you should take a pea sized amount for each cheek, and forehead and rub it in!!! i promise you, itll work better:)

this mask is AMAZINGGG!!! I got it for free as a gratis and I am obsessed! It is very expensive, but theres a LOT of product in one jar. I use it daily in the morning and have never had such glowey soft skin!!! I have struggled with terrible acne/scarring/texture for years, finally i found the perfect routine for my skin and this is a staple. I get compliments on how my skin glows! & i never get compliments on my skin so that shows me its working! It also smells amazinngggg! Seriously if your considering it, buy it! (especially if its on sale!, or if u have points and don't know what to get)

I used this one time and then broke out really bad over the following week, break outs are not the norm for me as I'm on medication for my skin. I also didn't like that you're supposed to leave it on.
My skin feels so much better! I am 72 yrs. This product is amazing.

avis.titre: BEST THING IVE PUT ON MY FACE
avis.texte: It's amazing and it smells delicious. My face feels plump and hydrated!

avis.titre: BEST THING IVE PUT ON MY FACE
avis.texte: It's amazing and it smells delicious. My face feels plump and hydrated!
It's alright. I don't think it did much or added much to my skin to justify the price little glow I guess but not really noticeable. Smells and felt nice but don't think I'll buy again.
It's alright. I don't think it did much or added much to my skin to justify the price little glow I guess but not really noticeable. Smells and felt nice but don't think I'll buy again.

avis.titre: Name is misleading. Not a mask!
avis.texte: Product is called a mask but really should be categorized as sticky tacky moisturizer. No where in the instructions does it say to leave on. I would never put make up on over this. I had to rinse off. Way too sticky and tacky. Wish I had never purchased. Sadly disappointed in Origins as I like their products.

If I could recommend anything it would be this. This is a great vitamin C mask to use. A little goes a long way and it's a leave on mask so no washing off required. Great smell and my skin has the best glow from using it.

This is an amazing moisturizer. My skin looks & feels amazing after just a few uses. Dewey…Well worth the money. Thanks ORIGINS!!! …………………,,..,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,………………………,……………..,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,…………………………..,…………………………………….,.,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,
